searchParameters.q: Oxyrase enzyme dissolved oxygen removal agar media

answerBox.snippet: Background: Oxyrase® (Oxyrase, Inc., Mansfield, OH) is an enzyme system that removes dissolved oxygen from liquid, gas or semisolid products. Oxyrase® is included in agar media that are typically used to grow and select for anaerobic organisms. Oxyrase allows the plate to remain reduced on the bench up to 2 hours.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is Oxyrase for agar?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Oxyrase® for Agar (OA) is a sterile, enzyme-based supplement that utilizes the proprietary Oxyrase® Enzyme System—consisting of bacterial membrane fragments and substrates—to catalytically remove dissolved oxygen from agar media, creating stable reduced environments for cultivating oxygen-sensitive microorganisms.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What agar is used for anaerobic bacteria?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Anaerobic Agar is recommended for the cultivation of anaerobic bacteria, especially the Clostridium species. Anaerobic Agar was originally designed for the surface cultivation of members of the genus Clostridium and other anaerobic organisms in plates.
